mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.event_id, d.rule_version_id, d.strength, d.decision, d.reason, d.work_item_id, d.create_at, e.subject_key, e.workspace_id FROM orch_decision d LEFT JOIN orch_event e ON e.id = d.event_id WHERE d.create_at >= #{from} AND d.create_at <= #{to} ORDER BY d.create_at ASC, d.id ASC
